ja: 「機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY」に登場する“デスティニーガンダム”がSDのプラモデルになりました。背中のウイングが羽ばたくように可動し光の翼もクリアパーツの着脱により再現。大型ビームランチャーを背中に装着したまま砲撃形態に可動できます。付属の豊富なパーツ類により、多くの劇中名シーンが再現できます。
更に、特徴的なビーム兵器「パルマフィオキーナ」をSDならではの個性的なディフォルメで表現。
en: “Destiny Gundam” that appears in “Mobile Suit GundamSEED DESTINY” has become an SD plastic model. The wings on the back move as if flapping, and the wings of light are also reproduced by attaching and detaching clear parts. It can be moved into a bombardment mode with the large beam launcher attached to its back. Many famous scenes from the play can be recreated with the rich variety of parts included.
Furthermore, the characteristic beam weapon "Palma Fiochina" is expressed with a unique deformation unique to SD.
